posts.text: Tbf I was the dumbass trying to install a window unit in a window that was essentially the minimum viable size for the unit

Weep for me, as I was lied to about the ease of installation of one New Window A/C Unit

It's done now but at what cost?

So what happens once we've finally finished perfectly automating sending emails back and forth forever using AI

What do we do as a species if our calling has been replaced?

It's wild to see clips of pundits on TV talking about how gutting the voting rights act has been a pet project of Roberts for decades and it's just like a little fun fact that he has a lifelong dedication to disenfranchising minorities from a position of near absolute power

Picked up a little something in LA 🥹

Afterlight won Best Ensemble Cast: Actual Play at the LA Webfest and I couldn’t be prouder.

Thank you to everyone who listened and loved our sad little show. For a story about spending the end with the people you love, this award feels pretty dang appropriate.

I regret to inform everyone that I, too, am shutting down my airline due to the Iran war

I believe I can identify the exact moment that TikTok started to truly die:

When they took away the ability to pin comments

If you missed it earlier, you can learn all about the wild world of BP shareholder meeting drama in today’s episode of Stuff Keeps Happening

youtu.be/nqb2PdZ_WhY

I made the mistake of quoting the national average gas price in todays episode of Stuff Keeps Happening

by the time I went to edit, the price went up 8 cents

by tthe time I went to post, the note I added during the edit about the price going up was outdated because the price went up again

This little number brought to you by the same political party whose primary economic story up until February was, "we're bringing down the price of energy which will in turn bring down the price of everything!" before starting a war of choice that brought the global energy trade to its knees

(Context: apnews.com/article/cong...)

[and yes that is the flag of Liberia]

But what do I know, maybe "attempting to cancel an election right as voting starts so that we can redraw voting districts before voting for the election that is actively happening right now" is a GREAT way to get everyone to show up and gleefully participate in democracy 🇱🇷🇱🇷🇱🇷
The people who constantly shout about wanting free and fair elections sure do seem to want to control every single aspect of said elections
The obvious solution is for everyone to stop saying "86" (dangerous, combative) and instead start saying "ayo fucking kill that guy" (clear, declarative)

I do not need to run an AI system to pick a backing track for the video that I'm otherwise producing

I'm producing the video. It has the backing track that I chose for it.

I am so exhausted by every single platform pushing some bullshit AI features that puport to replace some kind of step in the creative process

I’m doing the creative process because that is *the point of the creative process* and *why my content is enjoyed by my audience*
It’d be threat to *not* 86 the bud light

Today's Stuff Keeps Happening is out!

Where we're at with the Iran war, an inversion of the AI pricing game, a shareholder revolt (kinda) at BP's annual meeting, and an ancient discovery that's got me genuinely giddy.
